{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-f2z0","title":"[review] project-LICHEN-worker6-p0rc: TH_3/TH_4 transcript hash uses concatenation instead of CBOR array","description":"Commit 4d37021 correctly fixed TH_2 computation from raw byte concatenation to `cbor2.dumps([...])`, but TH_3 and TH_4 at four call sites still use the old concatenation pattern:

- Line 424: `cbor2.dumps(self._th_3) + cbor2.dumps(ciphertext_3)` → should be `cbor2.dumps([self._th_3, ciphertext_3])`

Per RFC 9528 §3.4, transcript hash TH(X) takes a CBOR data item (array). `cbor2.dumps([a,b,c])` produces `83 <enc_a> <enc_b> <enc_c>` (array wrapper), but concatenation produces `<enc_a> <enc_b> <enc_c>` (no array wrapper). These produce different hashes.

{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-f2z0","title":"[review] project-LICHEN-worker6-p0rc: TH_3/TH_4 transcript hash uses concatenation instead of CBOR array","description":"Commit 4d37021 correctly fixed TH_2 computation from raw byte concatenation to `cbor2.dumps([...])`, but TH_3 and TH_4 at four call sites still use the old concatenation pattern:

**EdhocInitiator:**

- Line 424: `cbor2.dumps(self._th_3) + cbor2.dumps(ciphertext_3)` → should be `cbor2.dumps([self._th_3, ciphertext_3])`

**EdhocResponder:**
- Line 608: same TH_3 pattern as line 379
- Line 678: same TH_4 pattern as line 424

Per RFC 9528 §3.4, transcript hash TH(X) takes a CBOR data item (array). `cbor2.dumps([a,b,c])` produces `83 <enc_a> <enc_b> <enc_c>` (array wrapper), but concatenation produces `<enc_a> <enc_b> <enc_c>` (no array wrapper). These produce different hashes.
